Forbric crash analysis
======================

These mods clash with each other — the error names them together:

  Chloride 1.8.1  (chloride)
    the error names it as clashing with another mod

  Cubes Without Borders 4.1.0+26.2  (cwb)
    the error names it as clashing with another mod

  Sodium 0.9.2+mc26.2  (sodium)
    its mixin was running

What to do
----------
Chloride, Cubes Without Borders cannot be installed together: keep one of them, take the
other out of your mods folder and start again.
This is a guess: it says these mods were in the error, not that they are at fault.
The full error is in crash-reports/crash-2026-10-01_12.00.00-client.txt.
